snippet.title: [KORD] CHICAGO O'HARE Intl. Airport By Feelthere for Tower! Simulator 3
snippet.description:
https://feelthere.com/shop/advertising/kord-chicago-tower-simulator/

About:

Step into the supervising role at one of the world’s most iconic and busiest aviation hubs: Chicago O’Hare International Airport (KORD). Situated on the northwest side of Chicago, this super-hub blends immense scale, varied traffic flows, and full-sized international operations to deliver an ATC simulator experience you’ll never forget.

As the air traffic controller, you’ll manage massive volumes of flights — short-haul, long-haul, cargo and regional — across multiple parallel runways, complex taxiway systems, and heavy ground movements. With operations numbering in the hundreds of thousands annually and nonstop service to destinations all around the globe, O’Hare challenges you to keep arrivals, departures and ground operations moving with precision and efficiency.

Built for Tower! Simulator 3, this detailed add-on brings the full scale of a global aviation hub to your desktop: authentic runway layouts, high-traffic sequencing, bustling apron and ground operations and the freedom to fine-tune traffic loads, aircraft mix, weather and time of day for your ideal challenge.

Features:

- Realistic recreation of Chicago O’Hare International Airport (KORD) with accurate runways, taxiways and terminals.
- Multiple parallel and intersecting runways enabling high traffic-throughput and complex sequencing.
- Handles the full range of aircraft types: from regional jets to wide-body international heavyweights.
- Customizable traffic density, weather conditions and scenarios to tailor the experience, using MIYO.
